description: Rubric for a single persuasive paragraph of roughly 60 to 140 words. Weights sum to 100. Level 4 is proficient, level 1 is preemerging.

levels.name: proficient
levels.descriptor: The first or second sentence states one specific, arguable claim, and every later sentence works to defend that same claim.

levels.name: progressing
levels.descriptor: An arguable claim is present but it is vague, appears late in the paragraph, or is split across two sentences.

levels.name: beginning
levels.descriptor: A topic is named but the writer never takes a position that someone could disagree with.

levels.name: preemerging
levels.descriptor: No topic or claim can be identified, or there is no text.

levels.name: proficient
levels.descriptor: At least two distinct, specific pieces of support (a number, a named event, a concrete example) each appear with a stated reason connecting them to the claim.

levels.name: progressing
levels.descriptor: One specific piece of support is connected to the claim with a reason, or two pieces are mentioned without any connecting reason.

levels.name: beginning
levels.descriptor: Support is asserted only in general terms (for example 'everyone knows' or 'studies show') with no specific example.

levels.name: preemerging
levels.descriptor: No support of any kind is offered, or there is no text.

levels.name: proficient
levels.descriptor: The claim, the support, and a closing sentence appear in that order, and a transition word or phrase links each sentence to the one before it.

levels.name: progressing
levels.descriptor: The order is mostly logical, but one sentence is out of place or several sentences lack any transition.

levels.name: beginning
levels.descriptor: The sentences are on topic but appear in no discernible order, or the paragraph stops without a closing sentence.

levels.name: preemerging
levels.descriptor: There is no paragraph structure: fragments, a single sentence, or no text.

levels.name: proficient
levels.descriptor: There are no errors in spelling, punctuation, capitalization, or sentence boundaries.

levels.name: progressing
levels.descriptor: There are one or two errors, and none of them obscures the meaning of a sentence.

levels.name: beginning
levels.descriptor: There are three or more errors, or one error that changes the meaning of a sentence.

levels.name: preemerging
levels.descriptor: Errors make most sentences hard to read, or there is no text.
